title: Planning a Nile cruise
standfirst: The practical side of a Nile cruise: how many nights to choose, whether a cruise suits you better than a land tour, and how tipping works. This is part of our [[up]].

sections.heading: The order to decide in
paragraphs: Choose the route and the dates first, then the boat, then the cabin. Book flights and transfers around the cruise’s check-in and check-out times, which each cruise shows.

sections.heading: What to book separately
paragraphs: Flights, airport transfers, extra tours and nights in hotels before or after the cruise. Nilecruz lists transfers and tours separately so you add only what you need.

faqs.q: How far ahead should I book?
faqs.a: For the cooler months and especially Christmas and New Year, several months ahead. Summer cruises can be booked closer to the date.
Choose the cruise first, then book flights that fit its check-in and check-out.
